understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the + goal gem by navigating horizontally through the tile grid and falling in the current gravity direction until landing on it.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift horizontally, then gravity automatically carries the player to the landing tile or next supported position. Gravity was DOWN in this attempt, with falling toward smaller y values. CLICK removes a clickable breakable tile at the specified position and can trigger an immediate fall if it opens a path; clicks do not consume movement-platform time. Spikes cause immediate failure, safe support tiles allow landing, and UNDO reverts the previous action.
